commands:
cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Run mypy type checking on all Python files in src/

# Find all Python files in src/
PY_FILES=$(find src/ -type f -name "*.py")

if [ -z "$PY_FILES" ]; then
    echo "No Python files found in src/"
    exit 0
fi

# Run mypy on the found Python files
echo "Running mypy type-checking..."
mypy $PY_FILES

# Check exit code
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Type-checking failed. Commit blocked."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Type-checking passed."
exit 0
EOF

cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Run mypy type checking on staged Python files in src/

# Get staged Python files in src/
STAGED_FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep "^src/.*\.py$")

if [ -z "$STAGED_FILES" ]; then
    echo "No staged Python files in src/ to check"
    exit 0
fi

# Run mypy on the staged Python files
echo "Running mypy type-checking on staged files..."
mypy $STAGED_FILES

# Check exit code
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Type-checking failed. Commit blocked."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Type-checking passed."
exit 0
EOF

cd /tmp && mkdir test_repo && cd test_repo && git init && git config user.email "test@example.com" && git config user.name "Test" && echo "print(1)" > test.py && git add test.py && git commit -m "initial"
cd /tmp/test_repo && echo "# typed marker" > marker && git add marker && git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep "^src/.*\.py$"
ls -la src/py.typed && echo "--- Hook content ---" && cat .git/hooks/pre-commit
